tweets: Starting a peptide telehealth company means threading a needle: physician oversight, 503A compounding, and zero room for 'research chemical' gray areas. Here's how we're building VendraRx to clear every regulatory bar. (1/5)

First rule: no research peptides. Ever. Every compound we work with is 503A-compounded under physician supervision—not sourced from 'labs' or sold for 'research.' This isn't a gray-market operation; it's clinically supervised care. (2/5)
Telehealth adds another layer: asynchronous physician review, state-by-state licensing, and labs/follow-up where clinically appropriate. We don't auto-approve—every case gets human review. (3/5)

The evidence matters. We won't hype unproven claims, because credibility dies the moment someone fact-checks and finds fabricated precision. What's actually in the literature? That's the only thing we'll discuss. (4/5)
